content.title: About
content.content: Bagel with wheat bran is a whole‑grain bakery product made from wheat flour, wheat bran and yeast. The bran gives it a nutty aroma, a dense crumb and a higher fiber content.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Wheat bran is the outer layer of the grain, rich in fiber, B‑vitamins and minerals.
Bagels are traditionally shaped as a ring; adding bran makes them more nutritious without losing shape.
Bran can help lower blood glucose by slowing carbohydrate absorption.
In some countries bagels with bran are served for breakfast with cottage cheese or yogurt.
Wheat bran is often used in diet plans for weight control.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Bran provides soluble and insoluble fiber that supports healthy digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains thiamine, niacin and folate, which are essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Rich in magnesium, iron and zinc, supporting muscle function and immune health.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: The high fiber content causes a slower rise in blood sugar after eating.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Fiber helps lower LDL (bad) cholesterol levels.

items.title: Wheat allergy or gluten intolerance
items.content: People with wheat allergy or celiac disease should avoid this product.

items.title: High fiber load
items.content: Excessive bran intake may cause bloating, gas or diarrhea.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytates can reduce the absorption of certain minerals if consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bagel can be eaten plain as a snack, sliced and topped with cream cheese, avocado, smoked salmon, or used for open‑face sandwiches. Light toasting enhances texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep bagels in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days. For longer storage refrigerate (up to 7 days) or freeze (up to 3 months).
